title: How are you blowing?
html_source: Another pun to add to the litany in this chapter – Joyce as paronomasiac runs riot here – a play on Dublin slang for ‘How’s it going?’ combined with a reference to the gale in the Odyssey that strands them on the Cyclops' shore.
